interpretation.canonical_failure: the exact current version's receipt-bound session is a genuine model failure; this does not prove that every other attempt on the task failed
interpretation.excluded: has an exact historical receipt but is outside the 75-task set because the current quality review marks it broken
interpretation.failure_only: not computed because the safe session-summary route does not expose exact task versions, so it cannot exclude a different successful attempt on the same key
interpretation.high_quality: passes the conservative 75-task current quality filter
interpretation.missing_receipt: this refresh has no exact current-version execution receipt; it does not prove that the task was never executed
interpretation.success: the exact current version's receipt-bound session is completed, has a healthy verifier execution, and meets the repository's full-success threshold

purpose: task-key-only successful-demonstration coverage for training planning
